policies.name: Clinician approves all patient messages
policies.description: No patient message leaves this software until a clinician approves it.

policies.name: Voice edits need confirmation
policies.description: A spoken change is only a draft until someone confirms it.

policies.name: Imaging reviewed by a clinician before use
policies.description: Scans stay unreviewed until a clinician has looked at them.

policies.name: Patient data masked on shared screens
policies.description: Names and record numbers are hidden on screens other people can see.

policies.name: Audit log records confirmed changes only
policies.description: A change is written to the audit log after confirmation, not when it is drafted.

humanInTheLoop.label: A surgeon confirms every patient message
A nurse confirms every record change
Scans are reviewed by a clinician before use
Emergency paging stays under clinician control
